$comment: Source index for core/authorization/fetch_states.py. ONE ENTRY IS REAL. The rest have url: null on purpose — a fabricated URL is worse than an absent one, because the fetcher would dutifully download whatever is at it. Find your own state's URL, verify it serves statutory text rather than an app shell, and add it with your row. See PROCEDURE.md.

how_to_add.name: state name
how_to_add.url: a URL that serves the STATUTE TEXT, not a search page or an app shell
how_to_add.slug: short id for the filename, e.g. hs-692A
how_to_add.renderer: 'browser' if the site is a SPA and curl cannot reach the text; omit otherwise
how_to_add.note: anything the next contributor needs to know
